title: Bu-Sui-Dan promotes angiogenesis to mitigate age-related osteoporosis via the ZEB1/Notch1 axis.
authors: Liao, Yitao; Zeng, Wenxing; Xiao, Qingming; Xie, Xuanyu; Yang, Yifan; Li, Chao; Zhang, Xian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药补髓丹通过ZEB1/Notch1轴促进血管生成缓解骨质疏松，虽涉及ZEB1与DNA启动子结合及分子对接，但核心是骨疾病表型与湿实验验证，非TF-DNA互作建模研究，仅方法上可部分借鉴。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Bu-Sui-Dan (BSD) is a traditional Chinese medicine formulation first recorded in the Song Dynasty text Shi Zhai Bai Yi Xuan Fang for the treatment of "Gu-Wei" (bone flaccidity), a condition clinically corresponding to osteoporosis. Although BSD demonstrates definite anti-osteoporotic effects, the underlying mechanisms remain largely unclear. AIM OF STUDY: To explore the therapeutic mechanisms of BSD in age-related osteoporosis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Herein, we utilized LC-MS/MS to analyze the chemical composition of BSD. Naturally aged mice were utilized to establish the age-related osteoporosis model. Therapeutic effects were evaluated utilizing micro-CT, histomorphometry, and immunofluorescence. Interactions between BSD components and zinc finger E-box-binding homeobox 1 (ZEB1) were analyzed via molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis (MST). Epigenetic regulation of Delta-like ligand 4 (Dll4)/Notch1 signaling was assessed using quantitative real-time PCR, Western blotting, and chromatin immunoprecipitation. ZEB1's function was validated in vivo via short hairpin RNA (shRNA) knockdown. RESULTS: We identified 576 bioactive constituents within BSD. Docking and MST assays indicated that BSD active compounds interacted with ZEB1, exhibiting low-micromolar affinities. In vivo, BSD dose-dependently ameliorated osteoporosis, significantly improving bone mineral density, trabecular microarchitecture, and type H vessel formation. Mechanistically, BSD upregulated ZEB1 in endothelial cells, promoting its interaction with CREB-binding protein (CBP). This enhanced histone H3 (H3K4ac, H3K14ac, and H3K18ac) acetylation at Dll4 and Notch1 promoters, activating their transcription. Crucially, targeted ZEB1 knockdown in vivo abolished the BSD-induced histone acetylation, angiogenesis, and bone protection. CONCLUSION: The present study uncovered that BSD could effectively improve bone mass and type H vessels in age-related osteoporosis through the ZEB1/Dll4/Notch1 signaling pathway, suggesting that BSD could be a promising therapeutic agent for age-related osteoporosis. However, one limitation of this study is that only a single batch of BSD was used. Therefore, future research employing multiple batches is needed to verify the reproducibility of these findings.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：补髓丹（BSD）是一种传统中药方剂，最早记载于宋代文献《世斋百一选方》，用于治疗“骨痿”（骨软弱），该病症在临床上对应骨质疏松症。尽管BSD显示出明确的抗骨质疏松作用，但其潜在机制仍 largely 不清楚。研究目的：探讨BSD在年龄相关性骨质疏松症中的治疗机制。材料与方法：本研究利用LC-MS/MS分析BSD的化学成分。使用自然衰老小鼠建立年龄相关性骨质疏松症模型。通过micro-CT、组织形态计量学和免疫荧光评估治疗效果。通过分子对接和微量热泳动（MST）分析BSD成分与锌指E-box结合同源盒1（ZEB1）之间的相互作用。使用定量实时PCR、Western blotting和染色质免疫沉淀评估Delta样配体4（Dll4）/Notch1信号的表观遗传调控。通过短发夹RNA（shRNA）敲低在体内验证ZEB1的功能。结果：我们在BSD中鉴定出576种生物活性成分。对接和MST实验表明，BSD活性化合物与ZEB1相互作用，表现出低微摩尔级亲和力。在体内，BSD剂量依赖性地改善骨质疏松，显著提高骨矿物质密度、小梁微结构和H型血管形成。机制上，BSD上调内皮细胞中的ZEB1，促进其与CREB结合蛋白（CBP）的相互作用。这增强了Dll4和Notch1启动子处的组蛋白H3（H3K4ac、H3K14ac和H3K18ac）乙酰化，激活其转录。关键的是，体内靶向ZEB1敲低消除了BSD诱导的组蛋白乙酰化、血管生成和骨保护作用。结论：本研究揭示BSD可通过ZEB1/Dll4/Notch1信号通路有效改善年龄相关性骨质疏松中的骨量和H型血管，表明BSD可能是年龄相关性骨质疏松的有前景的治疗药物。然而，本研究的一个局限性是仅使用了一批BSD。因此，未来采用多批次的研究需验证这些发现的可重复性。
